surface: built-in image_gen via Codex CLI (imagegen skill), codex exec -m gpt-6-astra
requestedBy: user request 2026-09-30: new 2D image resources for the training ground screens must be drawn by Codex, not hand-made in code
alpha: native PNG alpha; no chroma key, background removal, recolouring or resizing
references: icon-hourglass.png and icon-repeat-runs.png from the rift result (style only: bold, solid, rounded, no outline)
review: Accepted 2026-09-30 by Claude: four solid off-white silhouettes with transparent surroundings (edge alpha at most 1), readable tinted at 12, 16 and 24 px. The game tints them at runtime: the pencil beside each skill, the rule book on the Hunt Edict button, the remove mark on an enemy portrait and the boss crown. The crown has rounded finials instead of the pointed peaks the prompt asked for; it reads as a crown and was kept.
note: Codex returned 1254x1254 files with a 253 white fill instead of the requested 1024 and pure white; both are kept unchanged. Unity imports them at 128 px (TrainingGroundArtImporter, ResourceTextureBudget).

assets.prompt:
Create ONE flat 2D UI pictogram icon. Square 1:1 PNG, 1024x1024, with a native transparent background (a real alpha channel, fully transparent everywhere outside the symbol). The symbol is a single solid pure white (#FFFFFF) filled shape, bold and simple like a solid Material or Font Awesome icon, rounded stroke ends, even stroke weight, centred with about 10% padding on every side, crisp anti-aliased edges. No gradients, no shading, no texture, no glow, no drop shadow, no outline, no border, no background shape, no text, no letters, no numbers. It must stay readable at 16 pixels.
Style reference: the supplied hourglass and repeat-runs pictograms use bold, solid white silhouettes with rounded ends and no outline. Match their weight and style exactly, keeping the new symbol clean and simple.
Return a transparent PNG with preserved native alpha: one isolated symbol, fully transparent surrounding and internal empty space, no scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard, floor, frame, or unwanted shadow.
